parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: A spherical planet can be considered as a point mass at its centre.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
On Fig. 1.1, draw gravitational field lines outside the planet to represent the gravitational field due to the planet.

{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
A satellite is in a circular orbit around the planet.

Explain, with reference to your answer in (b)(i), why the path of the satellite is circular.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: An object rests on the surface of the Earth at the Equator. The radius of the Earth is $6.4 \times 10^6 \text{ m}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Determine the centripetal acceleration of the object.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Describe how the two forces acting on the object give rise to this centripetal acceleration. You may draw a diagram if you wish.
